qs.subject: İngilizce
qs.passage:
I. Hello! I’m Elif.
II. Nice to meet you, too.
III. Hi, Elif! I’m Emre. Nice to meet you.
IV. See you tomorrow. Goodbye!
qs.question: Put the sentences in the correct order to make a meaningful dialogue about meeting a new friend.
qs.explanation: Önce selamlaşma/soru gelir, ardından cevap; teşekkür ve kapanış sona gelir: Hello! I’m Elif. → Hi, Elif! I’m Emre. Nice to meet you. → Nice to meet you, too. → See you tomorrow. Goodbye!.
